comment: Conformance certifies architectural roles (an Application Component realises Application Services), but no mechanism certifies that a conformant decision-support component executes published guideline content faithfully. A platform can pass every interaction test yet be unable to parse the L3 artifacts the architecture names as Required formats. Observed: an Aug 2026 scan of all 31 published WHO smart-* IG packages (4,052 resources) against a current FHIR-native platform found 259 resources - including every PlanDefinition and Measure in smart-immunizations - unparseable from a single model defect (ohs-foundation/kotlin-fhir#123). Role conformance would not have surfaced this; executing the published content did.

anchor.note: p.78; 98 l.958; 401-406 read as the printed page; section 3.6.5 agrees
